paragraph_audit.reason: Title identifies the document as a proprietary software license but imposes no operative duty.
Copyright and all-rights-reserved notice asserts ownership but does not itself state a behavioral duty.
The paragraph identifies the Software and asserts exclusive intellectual property ownership; it creates no operative behavioral rule.
Each enumerated action is prohibited absent explicit written permission from 10x.in.
The paragraph prohibits unauthorized reproduction, distribution, and commercial use of any part of the Software.
Provision is limited to authorized users under terms agreed with 10x.in; the operative user-access boundary is represented without inventing the contents of those terms.
Warranty disclaimer only; it imposes no behavioral duty for this activity-constraint extraction.
Liability disclaimer only; it imposes no behavioral duty for this activity-constraint extraction.
Licensing inquiry contact information is not an operative behavioral duty.
All-rights-reserved assertion does not itself state a behavioral duty.

coverage_notes.note: The text does not identify what constitutes authorization, how authorization is obtained, or the terms agreed with 10x.in; no additional permission or license scope is inferred.
Section 2 describes unauthorized acts as prohibited but does not define authorization. The stated possibility of legal action is not an additional behavioral duty.
The warranty and liability provisions, licensing-inquiry contact, title, copyright notice, and all-rights-reserved statement create no behavioral duties modeled here.
